name: Chair Squat

instructions.description: Place a sturdy chair behind you and stand with feet hip to shoulder width apart.
Reach your hips back and bend your knees until you lightly touch the chair with control.
Keep your chest up and avoid dropping heavily onto the seat.
Exhale and press through your feet to stand tall again.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use the chair as a depth target, not as a full rest.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Remove the chair once movement control improves.

commentsNotes: Use a stable chair that does not slide.
